templates.title: Species Specific Target Training
templates.goal: Develop a calm, voluntary species specific target training routine suitable for other.
templates.summary: Develop a calm, voluntary species specific target training routine suitable for other.

lessons.title: Introduce and reinforce
steps: Observe a calm baseline and select an appropriate positive outcome.
Reinforce small voluntary approximations toward the behavior.
Introduce a consistent cue after reliable success in a quiet environment.

safetyNotes: Use voluntary, reward-based methods; never punish or force the behavior.
Stop at signs of distress, avoidance, or fatigue.
Adapt all practice to the species and individual.

templates.title: Voluntary Care Routine
templates.goal: Develop a calm, voluntary voluntary care routine routine suitable for other.
templates.summary: Develop a calm, voluntary voluntary care routine routine suitable for other.

lessons.title: Introduce and reinforce
steps: Introduce the context or equipment at a comfortable distance.
Reinforce voluntary approach and calm participation.
Increase duration gradually; stop before signs of distress.

safetyNotes: Use voluntary, reward-based methods; never punish or force the behavior.
Stop at signs of distress, avoidance, or fatigue.
Adapt all practice to the species and individual.
